Public site: each publish checks this site against the app route by route; not checked: /api/player-log (the app reads ESPN for a card when he opens it; the site answers from the card file baked from the desktop's ESPN cache at its publish (site-src/bake.mjs bakeCards)); /api/player-usage (the app reads Basketball-Reference for a card when he opens it; the site answers from the card file baked from the desktop's cache at its publish (bakeCards)); /api/pull-status (the app reads this computer's cycle state and GitHub through gh; the site's status block reads GitHub's cloud runs and baked/meta.json itself (site-src/site-pull.js)); /api/minutes (GET minutes routes: the page never reads them (it only POSTs a move), and the site has no minutes engine in the browser; the engine's figures reach the board through site.json, compared on /api/slate); /api/slate/<slate>/change-log (the Log tab's lines grow with every save, so the site's copy is the log as of its publish; the site's other routes carry the figures the log describes); POST routes (a write lands in this visitor's own browser on the site and in Adam's files in the app; the routes that read them back are compared).
